name: Photoprotection + tinted sunscreen

name: Retinoids
caveat: Prescription strength and tolerability differ from cosmetic retinol

name: Acne actives
best_use: Lesion reduction with established topical classes
caveat: Products and combinations vary; irritation affects adherence

name: Fractional laser resurfacing
caveat: Clinic parameters do not transfer to home devices

name: Microneedling
caveat: Depth, sterility, and technique drive risk and result

name: Diode / alexandrite / Nd:YAG hair lasers
best_use: Durable reduction of suitable pigmented hair
caveat: Skin tone, hair color, fluence, and maintenance matter

name: Radiofrequency tightening
best_use: Selected mild laxity and skin-quality endpoints
caveat: Heating history and device feedback are often undisclosed

name: Red LED / PBM for facial aging
best_use: Low-downtime adjunct for wrinkle and skin-quality goals
caveat: Dose and wavelength are product-specific; effects are modest

name: Home IPL hair removal
best_use: Hair reduction for selected home users
caveat: Does not establish pigment or rejuvenation efficacy

name: Azelaic acid
caveat: Concentration and diagnosis determine fit

name: Vitamin C / L-ascorbic acid
caveat: Stability, pH, vehicle, and packaging matter

name: RF microneedling
caveat: Energy, depth, and needle geometry are device-specific

name: MFU / HIFU tightening
caveat: Home “HIFU” devices are not automatically MFU-V equivalents

name: Tranexamic acid
caveat: Oral route has different systemic risks from topical route

name: Niacinamide
caveat: Finished formulas and percentages vary

name: Topical signaling peptides
caveat: Peptide identity, concentration, and finished-formula data are often missing

name: Oral collagen peptides
caveat: Oral pooled signal is not interchangeable with topical peptide evidence

name: Zinc oxide barrier protectant
caveat: Facial anti-aging claims are extrapolated from protectant/wound data

name: Blue/red LED for acne
caveat: Small heterogeneous home-device evidence base

name: Pigment / fractional picosecond lasers
caveat: Recurrence and PIH risk require diagnosis and follow-up

name: 1927 nm fractional thulium laser
caveat: Home translation and darker-skin evidence are limited

name: PLLA / CaHA injectable biostimulators
best_use: Diffuse volume loss and selected skin quality
caveat: Material, label, reversibility, and injector skill are decisive

name: Microcurrent / EMS facial devices
caveat: Long-term independent facial-aging evidence is thin

name: EGF / growth-factor topical adjuncts
caveat: Delivery and finished-product identity are variable

name: Prebiotic / probiotic / microbiome topicals
caveat: Strain, route, formulation, and durability vary widely

name: 1726 nm sebum-selective acne laser
caveat: Promising recent data are not proof of home-device equivalence

name: Microcoring
caveat: Small and procedure-specific evidence base

name: Whole-body PBM
